name: graphpulse
description: GraphPulse - graph-powered web & product analytics for SaaS businesses

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web
scripts.lite: npm run build --prefix web && node server/src/lite.js
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
